KeibaiKoubaiPage.desc: TQC Co., Ltd. advises clients on leveraging the potential of the
KeibaiKoubaiPage.desc_after: to acquire high-grade Japanese properties at significant discounts compared to prevailing market valuations.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.h2_1: What are Court & Public Tax Auctions?
KeibaiKoubaiPage.p1: Court Auctions (Keibai) and Public Tax Auctions (Koubai) are official disposals of real estate conducted by Japanese district courts and tax authorities. The primary advantage is the opportunity to acquire prime assets at 30% to 50% below estimated fair market value.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.p2: However, unlike conventional real estate transactions, interior viewings are unavailable and complex legal tenancies must be investigated. That is where
KeibaiKoubaiPage.p2_after: and TQC's advisory team deliver essential value, minimizing legal exposure and maximizing rental yields.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.servicesDesc: Supporting investors at every stage from initial asset identification through bidding and tenancy handover.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.s1Desc: Aggregate court auction notices nationwide, matching listings against your specific risk and return criteria.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.s2Desc: Professional preparation of judicial documentation and bidding submissions with the relevant courts.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.s3Desc: Thorough analysis of the Three Court Documents (3点セット), occupancy rights, liens, and potential hidden liabilities.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.s4Desc: Projecting refurbishment budgets, net rental yields, and cash flow forecasts to optimize your portfolio.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.w1Desc: Comprehensive coverage of auction dockets from all 47 prefectural courts and municipal tax bureaus in Japan.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.w2Desc: Collaboration with judicial scriveners and attorneys to clear tenancy and possession issues before bidding.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.w3Desc: Multilingual assistance covering investor visa considerations, banking relations, and property ownership registration.
KeibaiKoubaiPage.ctaTitle: Invest Smarter in Japanese Real Estate
KeibaiKoubaiPage.ctaDesc: Review current court auction listings across Japan to identify your ideal high-yield property.
